risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and well quantified, with detailed disclosure of credit-loss modeling, goodwill exposure, funding costs, and year-over-year performance. Risk tone is moderately negative because earnings and net interest income declined, funding costs increased, deposits fell, and liquidity management required higher-cost borrowings. Extensive accounting caveats and cross-references add boilerplate and limit direct assessment of forward-looking loss sensitivity.
